purpose: Prevent grammatical or morphological variants from inflating the 1,001-word authority count.

governing_law.automatic_rule: A predictable grammatical form created from an admitted word does not consume another vocabulary slot.
governing_law.irregular_rule: An irregular surface form may receive its own slot only when it must be learned independently and materially changes ordinary usage.
governing_law.derivational_rule: A derivative noun/adjective/verb is not automatically collapsed; it must add a distinct everyday concept or function to retain a slot.

review_required.reason: -ing form may be lexicalized as an event noun
derived role noun may be distinct
derived person-role noun may be distinct
derived person-role noun may be distinct
possessive-pronoun function may be distinct enough for learner utility

execution_lock.requirement: Replace every rejected redundant slot with a genuinely new geometric concept before resuming construction.

traversal_state.ACTION_PERFORMED: Normalization law frozen and known variant families classified.
traversal_state.ENGINE_RESPONSE: Level 4 construction paused; 750 string count is not yet accepted as 750 lexical concepts.
